title: Normalized store event
description: Minimum store event. occurred_at is the event timestamp. correlation_id ties the event to one autonomous run.

event_id.description: Immutable id of this event. A replay of the same id is a duplicate.

correlation_id.description: Id copied onto the Pub/Sub message and the BigQuery row.

event_type.description: sale.completed lands in sales_events. inventory.* lands in inventory_events. agent.* lands in agent_actions.

occurred_at.description: When the event happened, with a timezone.
